title: Shakshuka
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add onion and bell pepper, and cook for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in garlic, cumin, paprika, and chili flakes. Cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in crushed tomatoes, season with salt and pepper, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Make 6 small wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook for 6-8 minutes until egg whites are set but yolks are still runny.
Garnish with parsley and feta, then serve straight from the pan.
